newsitem.title: UK: British oil, gas revenue rose in July - Royal Bank.
newsitem.headline: British oil, gas revenue rose in July - Royal Bank.

text.p: British oil and gas revenues rose by over five percent in July to 41 million stg from 38.9 million in June, the Royal Bank of Scotland said on Friday.
The increase, which left revenues 25 percent above July 1995 levels, was driven by a sustained rally in world oil prices despite a slight strengthening of the pound against the dollar.
Oil output rose by 2.5 percent to 2.5 million barrels per day (bpd) in July but remained 1.3 percent below production in the same month last year, the Royal Bank said.
Natural gas production in July showed a seasonal decline to 4.96 million cubic feet a day from 5.12 million in June.
The monthly fall was the fifth in succession but gas output remained 25 percent above last July's level, the Royal Bank said.
